name: carnet-member-switch
about: The identity menu: switching to Bruno, who has a PIN — a wrong one refused (401), the right one let in.

accepted.why: Android signs in with no Authorization header (ApiClient: the server refuses a stale token even on its open routes) where iOS sends the current member's, and reads the members again (GET /api/users) on opening the picker. The server answers both alike.
